title: Sun Life President and Chief Executive Officer Kevin Strain to speak at the Scotiabank Financials Summit

body_markdown:
TORONTO


, Aug. 26, 2026


/CNW/ -- Kevin Strain, Sun Life's President and Chief Executive Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the Scotiabank Financials Summit. He will be joined by Mike Rizvanovic, Managing Director, Canadian Financial Services, Scotiabank.


**Date:**


September 9, 2026


**Time:**


1:55 p.m. ET


To access the live webcast or a replay, please visit our Sun Life[Investor Relations](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759327-1&h=3263087907&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sunlife.com%2Fen%2Finvestors%2Fpresentations-and-events%2Fupcoming-events%2F&a=Investor+Relations) page.


**About Sun Life**


Sun Life is a leading international financial services organization providing asset management, wealth, insurance and health solutions to individual and institutional Clients. Sun Life has operations in a number of markets worldwide, including Canada, the U.S., the United Kingdom, Ireland, Hong Kong, the Philippines, Japan, Indonesia, India, China, Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia and Bermuda. As of June 30, 2026, Sun Life had total assets under management of $1.70 trillion. For more information, please visit[www.sunlife.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759327-1&h=3384168600&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sunlife.com%2F&a=www.sunlife.com) .


Sun Life Financial Inc. trades on the Toronto (TSX), New York (NYSE) and Philippine (PSE) stock exchanges under the ticker symbol SLF.


**Note to editors:** All figures in Canadian dollars.
